device_specs.description: Scrapes public smartphone hardware specifications (GSM Arena, 91Mobiles, manufacturer specs)

repair_prices.description: Scrapes publicly listed OEM and certified repair price cards (screen, battery, motherboard, charging)

resale_prices.description: Scrapes public secondary marketplace estimates (Amazon Renewed, Flipkart Re-New, Cashify, OLX)

service_centers.description: Scrapes verified manufacturer authorized walk-in and doorstep service center listings

recycling_centers.description: Scrapes registered CPCB and State Pollution Control Board e-waste recycling facilities
